description: This file declares the AckSender class, which implements the IAckSender interface for sending acknowledgments via IPC in the Rialto server component. It includes constructor, destructor, and send method declarations, and manages a shared pointer to an IClient object.

classes.name: AckSender
classes.description: Implements IAckSender to send acknowledgment messages over IPC, encapsulating an IClient shared pointer.

methods.name: AckSender
methods.description: Constructor that initializes AckSender with a shared pointer to an IClient.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment with the specified id and success status.
